question: Name the card and artist with the most ruling information. Also state if the card is a promotional printing.
evidence: with the most ruling information refers to Max(count(rulings.uuid)); the card is the promotional printing refers to isPromo = 1;
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist))) LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.name, T1.artist, T1.isPromo FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isPromo = 1 AND T1.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) = (SELECT MAX(count_uuid) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS count_uuid FROM cards WHERE isPromo = 1 GROUP BY artist ))) LIMIT 1

c.sql: WITH ruling_counts AS (SELECT c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.uuid) AS ruling_count FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid GROUP BY c.uuid) SELECT name, artist, CASE WHEN isPromo = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS isPromotionalPrinting FROM ruling_counts WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts);

b.request: List the name, artist, and promotional printing status (`isPromo = 1`) of each card printing with the highest count of matching rulings, including printings with zero matching rulings in the count.
b.sql: WITH ruling_counts AS (SELECT c.id, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo, COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_count FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid GROUP BY c.id) SELECT name, artist, isPromo FROM ruling_counts WHERE ruling_count = (SELECT MAX(ruling_count) FROM ruling_counts)
b.raw: List the name, artist, and promotional printing status (`isPromo = 1`) of each card printing with the highest count of matching rulings, including printings with zero matching rulings in the count.

d.request: Which card and artist have the most rulings (counted by ruling UUID), and is the card a promotional printing? Include cards with no matching rulings record.
d.sql: SELECT c.name AS card, c.artist, c.isPromo AS isPromotionalPrinting, COUNT(r.uuid) AS rulingCount FROM cards AS c LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid GROUP BY c.uuid, c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo ORDER BY rulingCount DESC, c.name, c.uuid LIMIT 1;
